petronus_classification.note: Use 1,200 sqft and 2 stories as conservative detached-ADU defaults until current local objective size and height standards are supplied. California law permits less restrictive local ordinances. Verify the 2025 Energy Code compliance path, utility configuration, and independent access for the actual project.

lot.note: California's statewide ADU framework generally limits required side/rear setbacks for new ADUs to no more than 4ft. The separate protected-unit rule preserves at least an 800 sqft ADU despite certain other objective standards; verify the current local ordinance.

ca_legal_limits.citation: California Government Code §§ 66314 and 66325 (verify current local ordinance)

structure.note: Slab-on-grade dramatically simplifies MEP rough-in vs Victorian raised perimeter. Platform framing means each floor is structurally independent — stair opening requires doubled headers.

bedroom_programs.note: Three distinct programs derived from blueprint analysis. Generator should select based on spec.bedrooms.

0.mep_note: Single wet wall rear-left contains bath and kitchen on opposite side. Panel in utility closet or exterior-accessible box.

one_bed.note: SnapADU 25x14 2-Story plan. Narrow stacked layout. All wet walls align vertically — kitchen L1 rear directly below bath L2 rear.

0.mep_note: Kitchen wet wall at rear-right. DWV branch exits slab rear. Panel in entry closet or exterior surface-mount. 6040 sliding window at front maximizes light on narrow facade.

1.mep_note: Bath stacks directly above kitchen — single shared DWV stack. 2668 door into bath. Vaulted bedroom ceiling enabled by flat/shed roof construction.

one_bed_single_story.note: Architectural3DModel 935 sqft near-square single-story. Larger bedroom + generous bath + separate closet room.

0.mep_note: Wet wall at right spine connects kitchen and bath in single horizontal run — no vertical stack needed. DWV exits slab right-side or rear. This plan demands a larger sub-panel (100A) given >800 sqft.

two_bed.note: SnapADU 2BR/2BA 30x20 2-Story plan. Near-square footprint, efficient vertical stacking. Kitchen island on L1.

rooms.label: Kitchen
rooms.note: SnapADU blueprint shows dedicated island — plan 4ft clearance on all sides of island

0.mep_note: Kitchen wet wall at rear-right. Half bath rear-left stacks below primary bath on L2. Two DWV branches tie into single rear stack. 30x20 footprint allows DWV gravity path without horizontal offsets.

1.mep_note: Both L2 baths tie into same rear DWV stack. Primary bath stacks above L1 half bath (stack continuity). Bath 2 connects via horizontal branch — slope 1/4in per foot, max 5ft horizontal before hitting main stack.

wet_wall.note: All wet rooms must stack vertically. Kitchen L1 must align under bath L2 to share a single DWV stack. In single-story plans, kitchen and bath share a horizontal wet wall on the right spine.

staircase.note: Stair placed on non-wet side (left spine or center) so wet wall and stair don't compete for the same structural zone. Tight ADU stair: max 3.5ft wide, min 80in headroom (CBC 1011.3).

hvac.note: Single mini-split per story is standard for CA ADU. Outdoor unit in rear yard keeps front facade clean. No ductwork — slab construction has no cavity for trunk lines.

sewer_lateral.note: CA code requires 1/4in/ft (2.08%) minimum. Use 2.1% for ADU laterals. If connecting to existing house lateral, verify capacity — ADU adds ~150 gpd.

water_heater.note: Verify the 2025 Energy Code water-heating compliance path and size the selected HPWH for the calculated demand. Air-volume, ducting, condensate, and clearance requirements are product-specific; do not assume 450 ft³ is universal.

under_threshold.note: A shared sub-panel may be feasible only after a CEC load calculation, feeder sizing, utility rules, and existing-service capacity are verified; floor area alone does not decide it.

over_threshold.note: A dedicated meter/service is a utility- and project-specific option, not an automatic floor-area rule. Confirm service capacity, metering policy, and lead time with the serving utility.

ev_charging.note: Verify the applicable 2025 CALGreen/Energy Code EV infrastructure scope, parking configuration, exceptions, load management, and local amendments.

solar.note: Verify the applicable 2025 Energy Code PV/battery compliance path and exceptions. Coordinate roof layout, structural loads, fire access, shading, and utility interconnection.

massing_hints.note: Modern CA ADU box aesthetic. Flat or low-slope shed roof with large windows. No porch. Independent entry door on front or side elevation.

known_constraints_summary: Use 1,200 sqft, 2 stories, and 4ft side/rear setbacks only as conservative defaults; verify current local objective standards and any state-law pathways
Independent exterior entrance required — cannot pass through primary dwelling
Verify the 2025 Energy Code water-heating path and the selected equipment's air, condensate, and clearance requirements
Cluster wet rooms where practical, then size and slope the complete DWV/vent system from actual fixture-unit and developed-length calculations
Sewer lateral: 4in PVC at 2.1% slope — verify connection to street main or existing stub
Verify EV infrastructure scope, rating, load management, parking layout, exceptions, and local amendments
Verify the 2025 Energy Code PV/battery compliance path and applicable exceptions
Choose shared versus dedicated electrical service only after a CEC load calculation and serving-utility review
Select mini-split or ducted heat-pump distribution from load calculations, envelope, acoustics, and available routing space
Outdoor mini-split unit must be 36in from property line (local zoning typical)
Fit a code-cycle- and occupancy-specific stair geometry, landings, guards, handrails, and headroom before finalizing wet-wall locations
Kitchen island (2BR plan) needs 4ft clearance on all sides — adjust footprint before generating

california_compliance.adu_specific_citation: California Government Code §§ 66314-66325; verify current local ADU ordinance
